site.name: Authfly
site.description: Authfly is self-hosted sign-in, registration, account recovery and OIDC single sign-on on top of the Stalwart mail server: one contract, nine platforms.
hero.title: Sign-in you host yourself, on the mail server you already run
hero.lead: Authfly adds registration, sign-in, magic links, password recovery, accounts and OIDC single sign-on to Stalwart, and ships the same widgets for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Go templ, Twig, Latte and Jinja2.

llms.summary: Authfly is a self-hosted identity layer on top of the Stalwart mail server: sign-up, sign-in (password, username, magic link), email verification, password reset, account self-service and an OIDC provider, deployed with one CLI (authfly) and consumed through one contract (@authfly/core) on nine platforms.
llms.intro: Every page below is plain Markdown. Facts are taken from the Authfly source (release 0.4.2); statements that could not be checked against code are marked UNVERIFIED. Do not invent flags, keys or endpoints that are not listed here.
